annotation.overview: Document the parameter to a function. Names, types, optionality, and defaults are all in the AST.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Parameter structure is AST-derivable (name, type, optionality, default), but complete documentation quality still requires human-authored parameter intent/description.

annotation.overview: Document the return value of a function. Return type is in the AST; description is human-authored.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Return type is AST-derivable, but meaningful return semantics and narrative documentation are not deterministic from syntax alone.

annotation.overview: Describe what errors could be thrown. With Effect-TS, error types are encoded in the E channel of Effect<A, E, R>.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Standard TS: generally not derivable because thrown values are untyped. Effect-TS can often derive candidate errors from Effect<A, E, R>, but this is conditional on resolvable E and still misses defects/opaque channels.
annotation.example:
/** @throws {HttpError} When the API request fails
 * @throws {ValidationError} When input is malformed */

annotation.overview: Declare generic type parameters. Fully in the AST as TypeParameterDeclaration nodes including constraints and defaults.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Type parameter structure is derivable (name/constraint/default), but type-parameter intent text is documentation-only.
annotation.example:
/** @template {string} K - Must be a string literal type
 * @template V */

annotation.overview: TSDoc equivalent of @template. Documents a generic type parameter.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Type parameter structure is derivable, but meaningful descriptive text is not.
annotation.example: /** @typeParam T - The element type of the collection */

annotation.overview: Document the type of an object/variable. Fully derivable from type annotations or inference.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Type can be inferred or extracted, but choosing what to document and normalization of human-facing type text is partially semantic.

annotation.overview: Document a custom type. In .ts-morph files, replaced by type aliases and interfaces.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Alias/interface structure is derivable, but authored typedef intent and naming conventions are not fully deterministic.

annotation.overview: Document a callback function type. In .ts-morph files, replaced by function type aliases.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Function signature is derivable, but callback documentation intent and naming are not fully deterministic.

annotation.overview: Indicate that a symbol inherits from a parent symbol. Heritage clauses are in the AST.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Heritage clauses (extends/implements) are explicit AST nodes. Extract via getExtends() / getImplements() on ClassDeclaration.

annotation.overview: This symbol implements an interface. Fully in AST heritage clauses.
annotation.astDerivableNote: implements clause is an explicit AST node on ClassDeclaration.

annotation.overview: This function is intended to be called with the 'new' keyword. In .ts-morph files, class declarations are explicit.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Class declarations are explicit, but use of class-tag semantics in JSDoc function-style constructors and intent text is only partially derivable.

annotation.overview: Document a collection of related properties (JSDoc-style enum). Not the same as TypeScript enum.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Enum structure is derivable, but semantic documentation of member meaning is not.

annotation.overview: Indicate that a function is asynchronous. Detectable from the async modifier flag.
annotation.astDerivableNote: ModifierFlags.Async on the function node. Trivially extractable.

annotation.overview: Indicate that a function is a generator function. Detectable from the asterisk token.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Generator functions have an asteriskToken on the FunctionDeclaration node.

annotation.overview: Document the value yielded by a generator function. Yield type is in the return type signature.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Yield type can often be derived from generator signatures, but narrative yield semantics are not deterministic.
annotation.example: /** @yields {number} The next number in the sequence */

annotation.overview: Specify the access level of this member. Shorthand tags @public/@private/@protected are preferred.
annotation.astDerivableNote: ModifierFlags.Public/Private/Protected on the declaration node.

annotation.overview: This symbol is meant to be public.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Visibility defaults and emitted docs can be inferred structurally, but public API intent is partly policy-driven.

annotation.overview: This symbol is meant to be private.
annotation.astDerivableNote: ModifierFlags.Private on the declaration.

annotation.overview: This symbol is meant to be protected.
annotation.astDerivableNote: ModifierFlags.Protected on the declaration.

annotation.overview: This symbol is meant to be package-private (JSDoc concept, no direct TS equivalent).
annotation.astDerivableNote: No TypeScript equivalent. This is a JSDoc-only concept for documentation purposes.

annotation.overview: This symbol is meant to be read-only.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Readonly/const shape is structural, but intent and edge-case semantics across transpiled JS are only partially derivable.

annotation.overview: This member must be implemented (or overridden) by the inheritor.
annotation.astDerivableNote: ModifierFlags.Abstract on the declaration node.

annotation.overview: Closure: marks a class or member as final and not intended for override/extension.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Final intent is an annotation policy in Closure and is not inferred from TypeScript syntax.

annotation.overview: Indicate that a symbol overrides its parent. TypeScript 4.3+ has native override keyword.
annotation.astDerivableNote: ModifierFlags.Override (TS 4.3+). Also detectable by checking if parent class has same-named member.

annotation.overview: Document a static member.
annotation.astDerivableNote: ModifierFlags.Static on the declaration.

annotation.overview: Document an object as a constant.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Const/readonly modifiers are derivable, but constant-tag intent across runtime mutation boundaries is partially semantic.

annotation.overview: Document the default value of a symbol.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Initializer expressions are derivable, but chosen human-facing default explanations are not.

annotation.overview: TSDoc equivalent of @default. Documents the default value of a property or parameter.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Initializer expressions are derivable, but documentation representation of defaults is not fully deterministic.

annotation.overview: Identify the member that is exported by a JavaScript module.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Export structure is derivable, but intended exported surface naming and documentation-level grouping are partially semantic.

annotation.overview: Closure: preserve a symbol/property name in compiled output for external use.
annotation.astDerivableNote: This is a compiler behavior directive, not a deterministic AST property.

annotation.overview: TypeScript 4.9+ satisfies operator in JSDoc form. Validates a type without widening.
annotation.astDerivableNote: The satisfies expression is an explicit AST node (SatisfiesExpression).

annotation.overview: TypeScript-specific: import type declarations in JSDoc for .js files.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Import declarations are explicit AST nodes. This tag is only needed in .js files.

annotation.overview: What does the 'this' keyword refer to here?
annotation.astDerivableNote: In class methods, 'this' is deterministic (the class). In standalone functions, requires explicit annotation or @this tag.

annotation.overview: Describe a symbol. This is the primary human-authored content and the main target for LLM enrichment.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Semantic descriptions require human understanding or LLM inference. This is the primary Layer 3 content.
annotation.example: /** @description Retrieves the user's profile from the cache or database */

annotation.overview: A shorter version of the full description.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Requires human authoring or LLM summarization.

annotation.overview: TSDoc block for extended discussion. Separates the brief summary from detailed documentation.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Semantic content requiring human authoring or LLM generation.

annotation.overview: Provide an example of how to use a documented item.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Code examples require human authoring or LLM generation. Validation possible via doctest tools (tsdoc-testify).

annotation.overview: Document that this is no longer the preferred way. Semantic meaning beyond just the flag.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Deprecation intent and migration guidance are documentation semantics; no deterministic AST signal provides equivalent meaning.

annotation.overview: Refer to some other documentation for more information.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Cross-reference choices are human-curated documentation structure.

annotation.overview: When was this feature added? Useful for versioned APIs.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Version information is not in the AST. Could be derived from git history (first commit introducing the symbol).

annotation.overview: Documents the version number of an item.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Version metadata is not in the AST. Typically managed by release tooling.

annotation.overview: Identify the author of an item.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Author information not in AST. Could be derived from git blame.

annotation.overview: Document tasks to be completed.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Human-authored work tracking. Not in AST.

annotation.overview: API Extractor: indicates an API item is in early development (alpha release stage).
annotation.astDerivableNote: Release stage is a project management decision, not in the AST.

annotation.overview: API Extractor: indicates an API item is in preview/experimental stage.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Release stage is a project management decision, not in the AST.

annotation.overview: TSDoc: indicates that an API item is not yet stable.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Stability status is a human decision.

annotation.overview: Indicates that an API item is meant only for internal usage. Should be prefixed with underscore.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Internal visibility is a release/documentation policy decision, not a deterministic AST property.

annotation.overview: TSDoc: indicates that a class should not be extended, or an interface should not be implemented by external consumers.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Semantic intent not expressible in TypeScript's type system. A human decision.

annotation.overview: TSDoc: explicitly indicates that subclasses may override this member.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Virtual-tag usage communicates design intent rather than deterministic syntax.

annotation.overview: TSDoc: documentation content that should be omitted from public-facing documentation.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Internal documentation notes are human-authored.

annotation.overview: TSDoc: indicates that a doc comment describes an entire package (placed in the entry point file).
annotation.astDerivableNote: Can detect if a file is the package entry point from package.json 'main'/'exports' fields.

annotation.overview: TSDoc: defines a label that can be referenced by {@link} tags using the selector syntax.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Labels are human-defined cross-reference anchors.

annotation.overview: TSDoc: documents an ECMAScript decorator expression.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Decorators are explicit AST nodes. The decorator expression and arguments are fully extractable.

annotation.overview: TSDoc: indicates that a property returns an event object that event handlers can be attached to.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Event semantics are a design intent, not derivable from types alone.

annotation.overview: Link to another item in the documentation or an external URL. {@linkcode} renders as code, {@linkplain} as plain text.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Link placement and target choice are documentation-structure decisions.
annotation.example: /** See {@link MyClass.myMethod | the method docs} for details */

annotation.overview: Indicate that a symbol should inherit its parent's documentation. TSDoc uses inline form {@inheritDoc}.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Can detect when a method overrides a parent method (heritage clause analysis). Could auto-suggest {@inheritDoc} for overrides with no custom docs.

annotation.overview: Document a JavaScript module.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Module structure is derivable, but documentation-level naming/grouping conventions are partly semantic.

annotation.overview: Document a namespace object.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Namespace declarations are structural, but namespace documentation intent/grouping is partly semantic.

annotation.overview: This symbol belongs to a parent symbol. Establishes containment hierarchy.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Parent-child relationships are mostly structural, but chosen membership projection in documentation can be semantic.

annotation.overview: Document a member (property or variable).
annotation.astDerivableNote: Member structure is derivable, but documentation-level member framing is partially semantic.

annotation.overview: Document a property of an object (commonly used with @typedef).
annotation.astDerivableNote: Property shape is derivable, but property-documentation semantics remain partially human-authored.

annotation.overview: This symbol is an interface that others can implement.
annotation.astDerivableNote: InterfaceDeclaration is an explicit AST node kind.

annotation.overview: Describe a function or method.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Function signatures are structural, but documentation-level function semantics are partially human-authored.

annotation.overview: Describe the events this method may fire.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Event emission documentation is not deterministically derivable in general codebases.

annotation.overview: List the events that a symbol listens for.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Event listener documentation is not deterministically derivable in general codebases.

annotation.overview: Document an event.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Events are typically defined by convention (string constants), not as AST declarations. Some frameworks encode them in types.

annotation.overview: This file requires a JavaScript module.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Dependency edges are derivable, but documentation-level requirement curation is partially semantic.

annotation.overview: Treat a member as if it had a different name.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Aliasing is a documentation choice, not structural.

annotation.overview: This object uses something from another object.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Borrowing is a documentation-level concept.

annotation.overview: Use the following text to describe the entire class.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Class descriptions are human-authored.

annotation.overview: This function member will be the constructor for the previous class (used with @lends).
annotation.astDerivableNote: Used in object literal patterns with @lends, which is a JSDoc-specific pattern.

annotation.overview: Document some copyright information.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Legal metadata, not in AST.

annotation.overview: Identify the license that applies to this code.
annotation.astDerivableNote: License metadata not in AST. Could derive from package.json license field.

annotation.overview: Identifies an external class, namespace, or module not in the current codebase.
annotation.astDerivableNote: External dependencies detectable from import declarations pointing to node_modules.

annotation.overview: Describe a file. Placed at the top of the file.
annotation.astDerivableNote: File-level descriptions require human authoring or LLM generation.

annotation.overview: Document a global object.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Global scope is structurally detectable, but documentation-level global intent can be semantic.

annotation.overview: Indicate that the constructor should not be displayed in documentation.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Hide-constructor behavior is a documentation rendering decision.

annotation.overview: Omit a symbol from the documentation.
annotation.astDerivableNote: A documentation choice, not structural.

annotation.overview: Document an inner object (contained within another, not on its prototype).
annotation.astDerivableNote: Inner/member placement is mostly structural but documentation-level classification may be semantic.

annotation.overview: Document an instance member (as opposed to static).
annotation.astDerivableNote: Instance/static shape is structural, but documentation intent is partially semantic.

annotation.overview: What kind of symbol is this? (class, function, module, etc.)
annotation.astDerivableNote: Syntax kind is structural, but reported documentation kind can involve conventions and presentation policy.

annotation.overview: Document properties on an object literal as if they belonged to a symbol with a given name.
annotation.astDerivableNote: A JSDoc documentation pattern, not structural in TypeScript.

annotation.overview: Document a mixin object.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Mixin pattern is a design choice. TypeScript can represent it but doesn't have a mixin AST node.

annotation.overview: This object mixes in all the members from another object.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Mixin application is a design pattern, not a structural relationship in TS.

annotation.overview: Document the name of an object. Overrides the auto-detected name.
annotation.astDerivableNote: This tag is an explicit documentation override, not a deterministic AST derivation.

annotation.overview: Distinguish different objects with the same name (e.g., overloads).
annotation.astDerivableNote: Variation numbering is a documentation convention, not deterministic AST output.

annotation.overview: Insert a link to an included tutorial file. Also exists as inline tag.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Tutorial references are documentation infrastructure, not code structure.

annotation.overview: Closure: compile-time constant controlled by compiler defines.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Const declarations are structural, but define-level semantics are compiler-policy metadata.

annotation.overview: Closure: marks an object/class as dictionary-like (bracket access semantics).
annotation.astDerivableNote: This is a compiler contract and cannot be inferred reliably from general AST shape.

annotation.overview: Closure: allows assignment with implicit type coercion for selected extern-style properties.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Implicit-cast allowance is compiler annotation policy and not deducible from syntax alone.

annotation.overview: Closure: marks an object/class as fixed-structure (dot-access-only semantics).
annotation.astDerivableNote: This is a compiler contract and not deterministic from syntax alone.

annotation.overview: Closure: explicitly marks a class as neither @struct nor @dict.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Unrestricted is an explicit annotation decision in Closure-style code.

annotation.overview: Closure: suppress selected compiler warning groups.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Suppression intent is external policy metadata.

annotation.overview: Closure: indicates an externs file definition boundary.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Externs boundary is documentation/compiler configuration metadata.

annotation.overview: Closure: disable aliasing transformations for a file.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Alias-control behavior is compiler optimization policy metadata.

annotation.overview: Closure: parse a file but do not compile it.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Compilation inclusion/exclusion is build policy metadata and not AST-derivable.

annotation.overview: Closure: indicates calls are free of observable side effects for optimization.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Purity guarantees are semantic and not deterministically inferable in general.

annotation.overview: Closure: marks Polymer element declarations.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Framework-level semantics are not deterministic from AST shape alone.

annotation.overview: Closure: marks Polymer behavior objects.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Framework behavior semantics are not deterministically derivable.

annotation.overview: Closure: structural interface-like contract annotation.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Structural shape can be analyzed, but record-tag intent is explicit annotation metadata.

annotation.overview: Closure: prevents property collapsing during advanced optimization.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Optimization directives are compiler-policy metadata, not syntax-derived semantics.

annotation.overview: Closure: prevent inlining of the annotated function.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Inlining policy is compiler optimization metadata and not structural AST semantics.

annotation.overview: TypeDoc: assigns an API item to a documentation category.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Category organization is documentation information architecture.

annotation.overview: TypeDoc: emits a symbol as a standalone documentation page.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Documentation page emission is a render-time policy choice.

annotation.overview: TypeDoc: groups related items within generated docs.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Group labels are documentation organization metadata.

annotation.overview: TypeDoc: hides a declaration from generated docs.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Visibility in rendered docs is a documentation configuration choice.

annotation.overview: TypeDoc: expands referenced type information in rendered output.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Render-time expansion behavior is a documentation presentation option.

annotation.overview: TypeDoc: inlines target type information in rendered docs.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Inline render behavior is documentation presentation metadata.

annotation.overview: TypeDoc: merge declarations into a named module reflection in generated docs.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Module merge behavior is a documentation organization policy.

annotation.overview: TypeDoc: mark a declaration as the primary export in module documentation.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Primary export status is a documentation presentation decision.

annotation.overview: TypeDoc: override reflection sort strategy for a declaration subtree.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Sort order is documentation presentation metadata.

annotation.overview: TypeDoc: prefers declared type for rendering over inferred expansion.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Declared-type rendering preference is documentation presentation metadata.

annotation.overview: TypeScript 5.0+: allows documenting individual overload signatures in JSDoc.
annotation.astDerivableNote: Overload signature structure is derivable, but documentation-level overload text/organization is partly semantic.
